LyraShield Engine is a controlled derivative of upstream Strix. The inherited telemetry stack (PostHog and Scarf clients in `posthog.py` / `scarf.py`) is **forced off** by the `lyrashield` product entry point (`lyrashield_adapter`), which sets `STRIX_TELEMETRY=0` before the upstream CLI runs. No remote analytics are sent in production. The code is retained only so the upstream substrate remains reviewable and so the bare `strix` dev CLI keeps its upstream behavior.

The bare upstream `strix` dev CLI (not shipped in this distribution) honors `STRIX_TELEMETRY=0` to opt out. The `lyrashield` entry point sets this for you; there is no supported way to re-enable remote telemetry through the product boundary, and re-enabling it would violate the LyraShield production contract.

Configure LyraShield Engine with environment variables or a JSON config file. The `lyrashield` entry point (`lyrashield_adapter`) accepts `LYRASHIELD_*` aliases for every `STRIX_*` setting; either form works, but `LYRASHIELD_*` is the preferred product spelling. The adapter also forces `STRIX_TELEMETRY=0`, sets `STRIX_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`, sets `LYRASHIELD_PRODUCT_BOUNDARY=1`, and only allows GPT-5.6 Terra or Luna deployments from LiteLLM/Strix-supported providers that currently carry them (OpenAI, Azure/Azure AI, and Bedrock Mantle).

Only approved GPT-5.6 Terra or Luna deployments from supported LiteLLM/Strix providers are accepted as the main model. The current allow-list is OpenAI, Azure/Azure AI, and Bedrock Mantle. ChatGPT subscription-backed models are supported by default; run `lyrashield auth login chatgpt` and use `chatgpt/<model>` for `LYRASHIELD_LLM`. Set `LYRASHIELD_ALLOW_CHATGPT_SUBSCRIPTION=0` to disable subscription auth. OpenRouter, Bedrock (non-Mantle), Vertex, Novita, Perplexity, Parallel, and local/self-hosted endpoints remain unsupported as LLM endpoints until LiteLLM's cost map lists `gpt-5.6` for their provider markers.
The engine stores configuration in `~/.strix/cli-config.json`. Specify a custom config file with `--config`:

| `STRIX_IMAGE_DIGEST`                         | unset   | Optional 64-character SHA-256 digest to verify after `pull_docker_image` completes (for example, `sha256:abc123…`). If the local image digest does not contain this value, the image is re-pulled before verification fails. |

| `STRIX_SANDBOX_ALLOW_HOST_GATEWAY`           | unset   | Opt-in `host.docker.internal` access. Do not enable unless an explicitly authorized local workflow requires it.                                                                                                              |

| `STRIX_SANDBOX_CPUS`                         | `2`     | CPU quota as a float (applied as `nano_cpus`).                                                                                                                                                                                |

| `STRIX_SANDBOX_DISABLE_NETWORK_CAPABILITIES` | unset   | Legacy compatibility switch. It is consulted only when the enable variable is unset.                                                                                                                                         |

| `STRIX_SANDBOX_ENABLE_NETWORK_CAPABILITIES`  | unset   | Set to `1`/`true`/`yes` to add `NET_ADMIN`/`NET_RAW`; otherwise both remain omitted.                                                                                                                                         |

| `STRIX_SANDBOX_MEM_LIMIT`                    | `2g`    | Container memory cap. Opt-out token restores docker's unbounded default.                                                                                                                                                    |

Path to a custom config file (JSON) to use instead of `~/.strix/cli-config.json`. Configuration is re-validated after this file is applied because `LYRASHIELD_PRODUCT_BOUNDARY` is set by the adapter.

Resume a prior scan by its run name (the dir under `./strix_runs/`). Picks up the root + every non-terminal subagent's full LLM history and agent topology. Skips fresh run-name generation. Cannot be combined with `--run-name` or any of `--target` / `--target-list` / `--mount` (the prior target list is reused).

The engine copies local `--target` directories into the sandbox one file at a time, which stalls on very large trees. When a local target exceeds the copy limit (see `STRIX_MAX_LOCAL_COPY_MB` / `LYRASHIELD_MAX_LOCAL_COPY_MB`, default 1024 MB) the run exits early and asks you to re-run with `--mount`.

The production entry point is `lyrashield`, provided by the `lyrashield_adapter` package. The adapter forces telemetry off, disables the upstream self-update check, supports the authenticated `chatgpt/<model>` subscription route by default, and re-validates configuration after `--config` is applied. The bare upstream `strix` executable is not shipped in this distribution.
